full_page.content:
Pg. 21. Handwritten notes - Retreat October 26-1936(copied a year later) of Fr. Venantius, O.M.Cap.
Conferences
..
I. Mystery of Sin - Its deformity known only - its effects - .. "They shall look upon Him whom they have pierced".
"Bretheren: I beseech you have a continual rememberance of the Passion of Our S.J.C."
II. All surpassing beauty of a soul in grace - beauty every- where - in the microscopic atom. .. in constellations of heavenly planets ....
III. Faith Greatest gift on Earth. Example of university student not able to start creed till professor helped him ...
IV. If I have spoken Evil give testimony of the evil: but if well why strikest Thou me? - Willful venial sin. Oct. 26
I. Christian Hope .... God Most merciful. . . Parables.
II. Love .. Crown of all virtues - and Queen of all.
III. Prayer ... "He who prays not needs no devil. .. He casts himself into hell," St. Teresa ... "He is already lost who prays not." St. Aloysius.
Oct. 27
I. Rosary next breviary ... manners of saying it.
II. Stations practice mode of prayer ....
III. Meditation - Stations, Rosary - Passion
IV. Beautiful, Solem Holy Hour. Oct. 28
I. Venite ad me ... Dicite a me ... et invenietis
II Memoriam fecit mirabilium Suorum
III. Dicite a me ... . Private audience with Jesus - King of Kings.
